scope: Visual review of 99 frames decoded from the final full 4K MP4 as eight contact sheets and four boundary sheets; additional independent review of 15 final-master decoded frames. This is sampled visual review, not continuous normal-speed viewing or listening.
summary: 查看了完整母版的 99 张解码样帧及转场联系图；独立复核另查 15 个最终母版时间点。所查画面未见闪白、黑帧、残片或字幕裁切。九组生活物件折为波形，180.6 秒汇成完整 ECG，182 秒交接位置与亮度连贯。179 秒左端仍有短暂局部叠线。

findings.description: Composition, brightness and subtitle continuity retained across the assembly point.
Vehicles pass the edge mask as complete occluded images; earlier floating wheels and windows were not seen.
Objects visibly compress into waveform segments and join the ending ECG without an object opacity exit.
Brief local overlap remains at the left side during convergence. At 180.6 seconds no residual fragments or gaps are visible.
ECG position, width and brightness are continuous in the before, at and after handoff samples.
Title, ECG and closing copy remain inside the frame with no sampled clipping.

limitations: Decoded-frame sampling cannot certify full motion quality, subjective musical quality or perceptual audiovisual sync.
The nine-scene layout makes each object smaller than a close-up; models and folding remain deliberately stylized.
